newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean stock body says approves three IPOs.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean stock body says approves three IPOs.

text.p: South Korea's Stock Supervisory Board (SSB) said on Friday it has approved applications for three initial public offerings (IPO).
Woo Bang Housing and Construction Co Ltd, which will offer 3.20 million shares at 12,000 won each.
SJM Co Ltd, an auto parts maker, which will offer 364,000 shares at 19,000 won a share.
Komtec Systems Co Ltd, a wireless telecommunications systems manufacturer, is offering 520,000 shares at 40,000 won.
The offerings will be held on December 23 and 24, and the shares will begin trading in early February, the SSB said in a statement.
